knowledge-base.name: verify-gate
knowledge-base.triggers: verify, evidence, finding, blocker, citation, hallucination, false positive, unverified
knowledge-base.overview: Verify Gate protocol — every finding must be proven from actual code before presentation. Structural enforcement via hooks prevents hallucinated or unverified findings from reaching the user.

principles.principle: Every BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM finding MUST cite a specific file:line
Every citation MUST be verified by reading the actual code
Unverified findings are worse than no findings — they erode trust
"No issues found" is always a valid and respected outcome
Finding something is NOT the goal. Finding REAL things is.

layer.name: PreToolUse on Task
layer.description: Injects verify gate instructions into every agent spawn prompt. The agent receives explicit instructions to verify findings and mark unverified ones.

layer.name: PostToolUse on Task
layer.description: Fires after every agent completes. Parent agent must scan output for unverified BLOCKER/HIGH findings. Unverified findings are either verified on the spot or dropped.

layer.name: Output Format
layer.description: Evidence column in tables and Evidence field in blockers make verification status structurally visible. NEEDS_VERIFICATION status triggers evaluator escalation.

layer.name: Evaluator Escalation
layer.description: When any agent reports NEEDS_VERIFICATION, evaluator-agent MUST be spawned to independently verify BLOCKER/HIGH findings before they reach the user.

example.evidence: VERIFIED: `const token = req.headers.authorization` — no validation before use
VERIFIED: `db.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=" + userId)` — SQL injection via string concatenation

example.why-bad: No specific file:line, no code quote, speculative language

example.evidence: UNVERIFIED — "the endpoint probably lacks auth checks"
example.why-bad: No line number, no code quote, "probably" indicates not verified

status-values.status: All BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM findings have file:line citations with code quotes
One or more BLOCKER/HIGH findings lack verification — evaluator-agent MUST be spawned
Applied to individual findings that lack file:line evidence

rationale.point: The rag_context enforcement pattern works because a hook fires at every spawn — no exceptions. The verify gate replicates this at TWO hook points: PreToolUse (construction-time) and PostToolUse (completion-time).
Output format changes make verification status structurally visible — you can't fill in the Evidence column without actually verifying.
The evaluator escalation path becomes mandatory rather than optional when NEEDS_VERIFICATION is reported.
False positives erode trust faster than missed issues. It is better to report 3 verified findings than 10 where half are wrong.
